name: Codex
description: OpenAI's Codex CLI, headless: one codex exec process per turn, resumed into a single thread. It cannot ask the user questions yet, and nothing stages the codex binary into the colony image.

requires.image: glibc + node >= 20 + the pinned @openai/codex CLI on PATH (npm install -g @openai/codex)

model.title: Orchestrator model
model.description: Model for the colony as openai/<model> or a bare OpenAI model id, passed to codex exec -m. Empty (the default) passes no -m: Codex runs on the CLI's own default model. A <provider>/<model> whose prefix matches a connection from Settings → Model providers rides the mothership's gateway on its openai wire instead — tokens and spend are accounted host-side and no OpenAI key is needed in the colony. Anthropic-wire connections and providers with no route are refused: codex speaks the OpenAI wire only.

subagent_model.title: Subagent model
subagent_model.description: Accepted for parity with the other agent modules, but unused: headless codex exec has no subagent split, every turn runs on the orchestrator model.

background_model.title: Background model
background_model.description: Accepted for parity with the other agent modules, but unused: headless codex exec has no background-worker split, every turn runs on the orchestrator model.
